risk_posture.label: Warm
risk_posture.description: The lab's own Sector Rotation read: cyclical sectors' 1-month relative strength vs defensives. Cyclicals leading = risk appetite running hot; defensives leading = money playing defense. Leading now: Cons. Discretionary, Health Care.
risk_posture.title: Risk Posture
risk_posture.subtitle: Cyclicals vs Defensives

trend.label: Cool
trend.description: Where the S&P trades vs its 50-day average, plus the strength of the last two weeks' move — percentile-ranked over three years. A stretched, fast-climbing tape runs hot; a broken, falling tape runs cold.
trend.title: Trend Heat
trend.subtitle: S&P vs 50-DMA + thrust

insider.label: Warm
insider.description: 494 companies saw open-market insider buying against 1379 with selling over the last 30 days. That breadth sits at the 21.0th percentile of the past five years. Inverted here, because insiders buy weakness and go quiet into strength, so a quiet tape reads as the hotter, later-stage condition. Tested against forward S&P returns the direction holds, but on a small and non-monotonic sample, which is why this carries only 5% of the gauge.
insider.title: Insider Breadth
insider.subtitle: Buying vs selling companies

growth_value.label: Cold
growth_value.description: Russell 1000 Growth against Russell 1000 Value. The ratio sits at the 6.4th percentile of the last three years and has moved -11.6% over the past quarter. Growth pulling ahead means the market is paying up for future earnings, which runs hot; value leading means it is retreating to cash flows it can see today.
growth_value.title: Growth vs Value
growth_value.subtitle: IWF / IWD style ratio

breadth_50.label: Warm
breadth_50.description: 304 of 501 S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day moving average — the fast participation read. Swings hard with every dip and rally, unlike its slower 200-day cousin below.
breadth_50.title: Fast Breadth
breadth_50.subtitle: % S&P 500 > 50-DMA

new_highs.label: Warm
new_highs.description: 131 stocks near a 52-week high vs 21 near a 52-week low (within 5%). A surge of new highs signals euphoria; a wave of new lows signals stress.
new_highs.title: Net New Highs
new_highs.subtitle: 52wk highs − lows

fear_greed.label: Neutral
fear_greed.description: CNN's composite of 7 short-term sentiment signals (momentum, breadth, put/call ratio, junk-bond demand, volatility, etc.). High readings reflect investor euphoria — historically a contrarian sell signal.
fear_greed.title: Fear & Greed
fear_greed.subtitle: CNN Sentiment Index

breadth.label: Warm
breadth.description: 372 of 501 S&P 500 stocks trading above their 200-day moving average. Healthy markets see 50–75%; above 90% signals euphoric participation.
breadth.title: Structural Breadth
breadth.subtitle: % S&P 500 > 200-DMA

credit.label: Hot
credit.description: Extra yield demanded to hold high-yield (junk) bonds over Treasuries. Tight spreads signal risk-on complacency; wide spreads signal stress. Inverted percentile over 10 years.
credit.title: Credit Spreads
credit.subtitle: High-Yield OAS

yield_curve.label: Neutral
yield_curve.description: 10-year minus 2-year Treasury yield. A steep curve is early-cycle and healthy; a flat or inverted curve marks a late-cycle market that is historically more stretched and froth-prone.
yield_curve.title: Yield Curve
yield_curve.subtitle: 10Y − 2Y Treasury
